the UPR pathway is a common mechanism in the development of neurodegenerative disease and that targeting the PERK arm of the UPR pathway with a specific inhibitor is a promising approach to prevent neurodegeneration in tauopathies.

the PERK-eIf2α pathway can be targeted for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.
